title: API tells a provider permission failure apart from a provider error
acceptance: A design names the API signal for each provider state the UI must show (unavailable, disconnected, expired, permission, provider error) and which ones the backend cannot yet tell apart.
The design says whether it needs a shared-contract or OpenAPI change and how iOS would consume it.
No UI state is added before the backend signal it depends on exists.
nextAction: Read the SPC-09 row and PROVIDER-TRUTH group in the Studio Pulse Check ledger, map today's ProviderError codes to the five states, then propose the signal design for owner approval. Coordinate with RF-134 (labels say what they checked). Surface: both.

evidence.summary: SPC-09: the UI models four of six provider states; permission and provider error need distinct backend signals first. Owner-blocked since 2026-09-17.
Moved from the plan's Backlog prose into a record; Phase 2 of the owner-approved phased plan (2026-10-29).
